topic: Store brand staples vs name brands on the identical grocery list (Griffin vs Nadia)

scenes.narration: Same cart, same food, eighteen hundred dollars apart every year. Today's training session begins now!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault in a gym holding two clipboards labeled NAME BRAND and STORE BRAND, comic burst banner reads EIGHTEEN HUNDRED APART, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Griffin and Nadia shop one store with identical grocery lists.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split gym panel of man griffin and woman nadia pushing carts, both holding papers stamped SAME LIST, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Both spend around eight hundred dollars on groceries each month.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, griffin and nadia at a checkout, a chalkboard stamped EIGHT HUNDRED A MONTH above them, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Griffin grabs name brands automatically from eye level shelves every trip.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, griffin reaching for glossy premium boxes on an eye level shelf, a banner reads EYE LEVEL COSTS MORE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Cereal, pasta, medicine, cleaning spray, all premium labels, no comparison.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, griffin's cart overflowing with premium boxes labeled CEREAL PASTA MEDICINE SPRAY, each with a big price tag, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Nadia checks the store brand version of every single staple.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, nadia crouching to a lower shelf holding a plain box stamped STORE BRAND beside a premium one, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Same ingredients, often the same factory, twenty five percent cheaper.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, nadia comparing two identical ingredient lists, a comic banner reads TWENTY FIVE PERCENT CHEAPER, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She keeps name brands only where taste truly matters, like coffee.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, nadia placing one coffee bag labeled WORTH IT into her cart of plain store brand boxes, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: One year later Griffin spent ninety six hundred on groceries.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, griffin slumped beside a gym scoreboard reading NINETY SIX HUNDRED SPENT, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Nadia spent seventy eight hundred eating the exact same meals.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, nadia flexing beside a gym scoreboard reading SEVENTY EIGHT HUNDRED SPENT, a plate of identical food, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Her eighteen hundred dollar difference fully refilled the emergency fund.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, nadia stacking bills into a gym locker labeled EMERGENCY FUND EIGHTEEN HUNDRED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Swap five staples to store brand on your next trip. Drop and give me twenty bucks!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault blowing his whistle in a gym, holding a clipboard reading SWAP FIVE STAPLES, comic burst banner reads TWENTY BUCKS, kids comic book illustration
